title: Precedence-Aware Resource Allocation: Extending the AUTOC Framework to Multi-Level Treatments
abstract: arXiv:2610.34812v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many real-world decision problems require allocating limited resources across individuals to maximize total benefit often through interventions that vary in intensity rather than binary treat-or-not decisions. In these settings, higher levels treatments require first applying lower levels of treatment, inducing a precedence constraint that complicates allocation under a fixed budget. While the causal inference literature has largely emphasized accurate estimation of conditional average treatment effects (CATE), recent work has shown that estimation accuracy alone does not guarantee effective resource allocation, motivating ranking-based evaluation frameworks. The Area Under the Targeting Operating Characteristic (AUTOC) provides an effective way to evaluate prioritization rules across budget levels, but existing formulations are limited to binary treatments. We introduce Multi-Level AUTOC (ML-AUTOC), which is a generalization for AUTOC

translated_title: 优先级感知的资源分配：将AUTOC框架扩展至多层级处理
translated_abstract: 许多现实世界的决策问题需要在个体之间分配有限资源以最大化总收益，这通常通过强度可变的干预来实现，而非二元的“是否治疗”决策。在这些情境下，更高层级的处理需要先应用较低层级的处理，由此产生的优先级约束使得固定预算下的资源分配问题变得更加复杂。虽然因果推断文献主要强调对条件平均处理效应（CATE）的准确估计，但近期研究表明，仅凭估计精度并不能保证有效的资源分配，这促使了基于排序的评估框架的出现。靶向操作特征曲线下面积（AUTOC）提供了一种在不同预算水平下评估优先排序规则的有效方法，但现有的公式化表述仅限于二元处理。我们提出了多层级AUTOC（ML-AUTOC），这是对AUTOC的一种泛化。
tldr: 本文提出ML-AUTOC，将AUTOC评估框架从二元处理扩展到具有优先级约束的多层级处理资源分配问题，填补了现有方法只能处理二元干预的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ML-AUTOC, a generalization of the AUTOC framework that extends ranking-based treatment evaluation from binary to multi-level treatments with precedence constraints for resource allocation under fixed budgets.
